items.text: All three workshop decisions (d1=A specific path patterns, d2=A swarm-manager-only scope, d3=A git rm --cached) have been incorporated into plan.md. The gitignore patterns section was corrected to remove the negation pattern (!api/internal/captures/) that contradicted the d1=A selection — specific paths naturally avoid the Go source directory without negation.

Added --ignore-unmatch recommendation and expanded git rm commands to cover all four item kinds (execute, fix, chore, idea) for completeness. Added explicit 'Out of Scope' entry for root .gitignore per d2=A. Added 'Resolved Decisions' summary table for traceability.

No remaining gaps. All five readiness dimensions score 3/3: the problem is fully understood, scope is tightly bounded with acceptance_allow patterns defined, approach is a concrete 3-phase plan with exact commands, testing has 4 verification steps, and risks are low with mitigations identified.

plan_updates: Corrected gitignore patterns to match d1=A (removed negation, anchored /captures/). Added Resolved Decisions table. Expanded git rm commands to all item kinds with --ignore-unmatch note. Added root .gitignore exclusion to Out of Scope.
